sampling.holdout_policy: midpoint between adjacent stage-4 range and angle samples
sampling.signed_bearing_policy: zero once; nonzero plus and minus
sampling.M_policy: observed and reported, never a binary optimization pressure
sampling.holdout_policy_role: observed and reported, never counted as material benefit

selection_policy.hard_constraints: stage-4 N stays robust hit; O stays robust miss
selection_policy.topology: one connected robust-hit band, no angular reversal, range multi-island, or internal hole
selection_policy.fallback: retain nav_gain=4 when no non-baseline candidate has clear net benefit

default_promotion_hold_reasons: stage-2 world_cv tracker reports acceleration_world_mps2 fixed at zero
stage-4 and stage-5 calibration authority covers only constant-velocity targets
maneuver-target and APN authority evidence is absent

required_next_evidence: maneuver-target envelope with nonzero truth acceleration
tracker acceleration authority beyond fixed zero
APN gain identifiability and holdout validation

limitations: The calibration target is the deterministic engineering CV envelope, not real missile performance.
M cells and half-step holdout cells have no real-world truth label.
APN remains unidentifiable because truth target acceleration is zero.
A retained N=4 result means no tested value showed clear constrained net benefit, not that N=4 is universally optimal.

raw_evidence.storage_policy: raw rows are retained in CSV and omitted from summary JSON
